comparison.objective: Commission a damper versus close and seal a swing-top bottle.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-mediated unlock, fine tuning, and relock versus positioning a stopper and driving an over-center lever while bracing a bottle.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe stops with retained adjustment versus stopper seated and lever held past center without tipping.
comparison.reason: Both include bimanual bracing and retention, but over-center closure is mechanically and behaviorally different from iterative dynamic tuning. All three spec versions support this distinction.
